classification.difficultyReason: Form equations from repeated unknown angles; the hardest part requires replacing the marked notch angle by its reflex complement before using the polygon sum.

content.prompt: Find the value of the pronumeral in these diagrams.

spec.description: Pentagon with two upper right angles and three interior angles labelled c. Ordinary source strokes are rendered black.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answer excluded.

spec.description: Pentagon with top right-angle square, 95 degrees at right, 100 degrees at left, and x degrees at both lower vertices.
Octagon retaining all eight angle arcs and clockwise labels 130, 150, 125, 125, 150, 150, d, d.
Concave octagon with central raised stem, four right-angle squares, two 100-degree shoulder angles and two reflex interior angles h.
spec.answerVisibility: Reflex unknowns retained; supplied answer excluded.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}S&=180(n-2)\\S&=180(8-2)\\S&=1080^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}2h+4(90)+2(100)&=1080\\2h+560&=1080\\2h&=520\\h&=260\end{aligned}$

Both angles labelled $h$ are reflex interior angles, so $h=260^{\circ}$.

spec.description: Hexagon retaining one identical side tick on each edge and the single upper-right angle label (one half x) degrees. No equal-angle marks have been added.
spec.mathematics: Equal sides alone do not determine the marked interior angle. If regularity is supplied, each interior angle is 120 degrees and x = 240.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied 240 excluded; missing regularity remains a finding.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}S&=180(n-2)\\S&=180(6-2)\\S&=720^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

The hexagon is regular, so all six interior angles are equal.

$\begin{aligned}6\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)&=720\\3x&=720\\x&=240\end{aligned}$

spec.description: Concave hexagon retaining 120, 50 and 70-degree labels and two right-angle squares. The x-degree label lies in the small exterior notch angle, outside the polygon.
spec.answerVisibility: The small notch angle remains unknown; supplied 60 excluded.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}S&=180(n-2)\\S&=180(6-2)\\S&=720^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

The reflex interior angle at the notch is $(360-x)^{\circ}$.

$\begin{aligned}120+90+90+70+(360-x)+50&=720\\780-x&=720\\x&=60\end{aligned}$
